newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT to transfer inquiry service to unit - paper.
newsitem.headline: NTT to transfer inquiry service to unit - paper.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) has decided to transfer its loss-making telephone directory inquiry service to a subsidiary, a Japanese newspaper said on Friday.
The domestic telecommunications giant is also considering raising fees for the service, economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
NTT spokesmen could not immediately confirm the report.
NTT announced last year its overall restructuring plan, including a cut in the work force, and the transfer of the inquiry service is part of the plan, the paper said.

NTT posted a parent operating profit of 441.12 billion yen in the business year to March 31, 1996, but its information service division posted a loss of 95 billion yen in the same year, the paper said.
